# NDI logo

`src/GridMapper.Desktop/Assets/NdiLogo.svg` is the original light master artwork from the official **NDI Logo (Docs and Guides)** package, downloaded 2026-10-14.

Source and brand guidelines: https://docs.ndi.video/brand/brand-elements/logo

The vector paths, colour, aspect ratio, registered mark, and supplied clear space are preserved. The application renders the asset as vector geometry for sharp display at different system scales.

NDI® is a registered trademark of Vizrt NDI AB. The asset remains the property of its owner and is not covered by this repository's software licence.
